paras: Calumma hilleniusi is a species of chameleon, a lizard in the family Chamaeleonidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
The specific name, hilleniusi, is in honor of Dutch herpetologist Dick Hillenius.
The preferred natural habitats of C. hilleniusi are forest and grassland, at altitudes of 1,550–2,550 m (5,090–8,370 ft).
C. hilleniusi is oviparous. A female may lay a clutch of as many as ten eggs.
